cohort: 1660 pregnant and postpartum women with confirmed COVID-19 admitted to BYL Nair Charitable Hospital in Mumbai, India, during the first and second waves of the pandemic, compared to women with EPs in the 4 years preceding the pandemic.
finding: The rate of ectopic pregnancies was lower during the COVID-19 pandemic overall compared to the pre-pandemic period, but higher during the second wave compared to the first wave.
